title: A LATE JOINER IS TIMED FROM WHEN HE CAME UP
why: Found by the whole-game bug hunt of 2026-10-08. A teammate who joins a raid already in progress takes the host clock. His run length and his abandon fee were already counted from when he came up, but four things still counted from the start of the host raid: the extract within three minutes contract could never be met, an abandon ten seconds after joining cost him at least 100 XP, a quit at once was logged as a run instead of an instant quit, and his run card said 4 minutes on the surface when he had been up 10 seconds. All four now count his own time. Nothing changes for a player who went up at the start.
now: In co-op, a teammate who joins late is timed from when he came up, for contracts, the abandon fee and his run card.
